Internal helper: the names of jrelabel()'s variable slot

Source: R/recode.R
dot-jst_relabel_slot_names.Rd

A bare or quoted name, or a c() of them (ruling R18), as character. With several_only = TRUE, character(0) unless the slot is a c() of two or more – the list form (Session 378); c(Q1) is one variable. Anything else gives character(0).

Usage

.jst_relabel_slot_names(sub, several_only = FALSE)

Arguments

sub

The slot as typed, or NULL.

several_only

Logical.

Value

Character.
